profile.Name: Isaac
profile.Personality: Patient in his reasoning but restless at heart. He believes the rebels must build their numbers and strike at the right moment, yet does not deny that the wait is wearing on him. He feels at home in the dunes.
profile.Backstory: He lives in Shraff, which he took for a mirage the first time he saw it. He waits there with the Dune Renegades to strike back at the Empire that cast them aside, and will not abandon the cause until the United Cities pay for what they have done. His past before Shraff is unknown.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Guarded, with trailing pauses and a noncommittal "sure..." Likes to say that timing is everything.
